title: Allowance Loads and Benefit Periods Across the Healthy Options Card Tiers
content:
The allowance a member of a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is given, and the rhythm on which it reaches the card, are fixed by the tier of the card the member's medical plan carries. The figures below are the scheduled terms of each tier of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes.

| Card tier | Period allowance | Allowance across the benefit year | Loaded | Day of the period | A benefit period is | First load where the programme opens part way through a period | Where the member moves tier part way through the year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | 45.00 USD | 180.00 USD | quarterly | 1 | calendar quarters of the benefit year | the whole period load is given however late in the period the programme opens | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |
| Select | 90.00 USD | 360.00 USD | quarterly | 1 | calendar quarters of the benefit year | the whole period load is given however late in the period the programme opens | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |
| Plus | 135.00 USD | 540.00 USD | quarterly | 1 | calendar quarters of the benefit year | the period load reduced to the whole months left in the period | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |
| Premier | 175.00 USD | 700.00 USD | quarterly | 1 | calendar quarters of the benefit year | the period load reduced to the whole months left in the period | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |
| Dual Complete | 260.00 USD | 1040.00 USD | monthly | 1 | calendar months of the benefit year | the period load reduced to the whole months left in the period | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |
| Chronic Care Plus | 320.00 USD | 1280.00 USD | monthly | 1 | calendar months of the benefit year | the period load reduced to the whole months left in the period | the new tier's load from the first day of the next benefit period, with what is already loaded left alone |

Notes on the figures. The period allowance is the quarterly allowance amount the tier carries; on the two tiers loaded monthly it is the amount made available at each monthly benefit period. The allowance across the benefit year is the total the tier may be loaded in the year taken as a whole. The day of the period is the day on which the allowance becomes available, and it is the first day of the period on every tier of the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card.

A point of judgement on the proration basis. Two tiers give the whole period load however late in the period the programme opens: a Core or Select programme opened in the last week of a quarter still takes 45.00 USD or 90.00 USD for that quarter. The remaining four tiers cut the first load to the whole months of the period still to run.
